svg.aria-label: Capability matrix. VIRTUALIZATION & HOSTING: Nutanix AHV / Prism, Proxmox VE, VMware ESXi. BACKUP & RESTORE: HYCU R-Cloud, Proxmox Backup Server, Datto Siris, Offsite S3 backup. NETWORK & SECURITY: Fortinet FortiGate & FortiManager, pfSense, Zyxel, VLAN / VPN, Certificate management. OS & OPERATIONS: AlmaLinux, Debian, Windows Server, Active Directory. AUTOMATION & TOOLING: Docker, Scripting, Reverse proxy — Caddy & Nginx, Centralized logging — Graylog.
